params.body:
The fiche was today's and nothing else (`worksheetFor(now())`), so a day the worker didn't get to in the evening couldn't be filled in the next morning.

- **Choosing a day.** Tapping the date under his name opens a day choice: Vandaag, Gisteren, Eergisteren, or any earlier date through a date field. A day still to come is refused, as is an invalid date. The choice is disabled during a call, because the voice would keep talking about the day it started on.
- **One place decides the day.** `App\Services\SheetDay` keeps the choice in his session for the rest of the day it was made. Signing in, or opening the app the next day, starts on today again. `RecordDay` and `ConversationController` both ask `SheetDay`, so the screen and the voice are always on the same fiche.
- **On the fiche.** While the fiche isn't today's, a strip says which day it is, with "Terug naar vandaag". The texts that said "vandaag" say "die dag".
- **Prompt.** It says the fiche is for that day and not today, and that "vandaag" further down means that day.
- **Office.** The Dagrapport row and the fiche show "achteraf ingevuld" for a fiche created on a later day than its date (`Worksheet::filledLate()`). Such a fiche can arrive after that day has already been booked.

Tests are in `tests/Feature/WorksheetOtherDayTest.php`:
- yesterday's fiche, with the conversation on that same fiche and its prompt;
- a future or invalid day refused;
- the next morning starts on today;
- signing in resets the day;
- the office marker.

Checked by screenshot on the werf demo at 390px and 1280px: the day choice, then yesterday's fiche with the strip, then back to today. The full suite passes (374/374), and Pint is clean.

No migration. This touches the header of `record-day.blade.php`, as the usual-day PR does, so whichever of the two merges second needs a rebase. I'll do that rebase.
params.title: Werf fiche: fill in any past day, not only today
